issues.problem: A New Year blessing (吉祥话), not a 成语; it does not belong in the chengyu core
issues.action: Replaced with 心甘情愿 / xīn gān qíng yuàn, 'fully willing, gladly accepting it of one's own accord', lvl 1, behaviour

issues.problem: Also in the guanyong list (a colloquial 惯用语); cross-set duplicate
issues.action: Replaced with 名副其实 / míng fù qí shí, 'truly living up to its name or reputation', lvl 2, appearance

issues.problem: Also in the guanyong list (a colloquial 惯用语); cross-set duplicate
issues.action: Replaced with 讨价还价 / tǎo jià huán jià, 'to haggle over the price', lvl 1, money

issues.problem: Meaning 'to make a fuss over nothing' was interchangeable with 小题大做's line; the core sense is overreacting with alarm or surprise
issues.action: Meaning changed to 'to be alarmed or amazed by something quite ordinary'

issues.problem: English idiom gloss read the same as 大惊小怪's line
issues.action: Meaning changed to 'to treat a minor matter as a major issue'

issues.problem: Meaning line was a conditional clause rather than a gloss and did not say what the 'bad thing' usually is
issues.action: Meaning changed to 'an unforeseen mishap, especially an accident or death'

issues.problem: Meaning covered only 忙得不可开交; the idiom is just as common with 吵得/闹得 (quarrelling)
issues.action: Meaning changed to 'frantically, unable to break off (of being busy or quarrelling)'

issues.problem: Meaning 'to bring trouble on oneself' was hard to tell apart from 自作自受 (cy089)
issues.action: Meaning changed to 'to ask for trouble by needlessly making things hard for oneself'

issues.problem: 'too late for regrets' reads as consolation; the idiom states that one regrets it when it is too late
issues.action: Meaning changed to 'to regret something when it is too late to undo'
